title: No way to configure visibility/history appearance for job progress notifications.
line: Apps that only show file transfer progress, like Dolphin, now appear in Configure for Applications, so you can stop their finished jobs from going into the history.
explanation: Per-app settings (Show popups, Show in history, badges) already apply to job notifications through the app's desktop entry, but an app without a notifyrc file only shows up in System Settings > Notifications > Configure for Applications after the applet registers it as seen. The applet only did that for normal notifications, so Dolphin and other apps that only report file transfers never appeared in the list and their finished jobs could not be kept out of the history. The applet now registers the app when any of its popups is shown, jobs included.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: register apps that only show job notifications

Apps were only added to the per-app notification settings after sending
a normal notification, so apps like Dolphin that only report file jobs
could not be configured. Register them when their job popup is shown too.

BUG: 524585

The finished Dolphin copy job lands in the notification history

review.text: Minimal and idiomatic fix in applets/notifications/global/Globals.qml that moves known-application registration outside the NotificationType-only branch so job-only applications like Dolphin get registered when showing a job popup. Because libnotificationmanager already applies per-app notification settings (including Show in history) to jobs by desktopEntry, this cleanly resolves the oversight without inventing redundant job-specific settings. Before/after screenshots convincingly demonstrate Dolphin appearing in Configure for Applications and finished jobs staying out of history once unchecked.

reviews.text: Minimal and idiomatic fix in applets/notifications/global/Globals.qml that moves known-application registration outside the NotificationType-only branch so job-only applications like Dolphin get registered when showing a job popup. Because libnotificationmanager already applies per-app notification settings (including Show in history) to jobs by desktopEntry, this cleanly resolves the oversight without inventing redundant job-specific settings. Before/after screenshots convincingly demonstrate Dolphin appearing in Configure for Applications and finished jobs staying out of history once unchecked.

Small, clean change in the right place: job-only apps like Dolphin were never registered as seen, so they could not be configured, and per-app Show in history already applies to jobs through the desktop entry. This delivers what Nate asked for in c6 (uncheck Show in history per app for job notifications); the reporter's ideal (keep in history but not counted as new) is not addressed, but that is a separate design question. Evidence shows Dolphin appearing in the KCM and its finished job staying out of history, and the regression check covers normal notifications and another app's jobs.
